[h1][b]A basic casual game with some surprising mechanics[/b][/h1]

[h3] [b]What this game is:[/b][/h3] A casual action game full of basic clichés where the main protagonist (you) is trying to act like a «real» slav, hence the name of the game.  

[h3] [b]How does it work?[/b][/h3]  You are basically presented with three different games in one. Passed the main screen, where you have to select either "Russia", "Balkan", or "Poland", you end up in a minigame here you have to do some stuff to survive.  In "Russia" you have to survive as long as possible by drinking vodka, getting some speed and protection buff, which will help you survive a bear and an emptying red star.  In "Balkan" you have tu survive a bar brawl where some alcohol bottles will help heal you and you own brawling instinct (basically swinging your arm) will help you beat-up or kill opponents.  In "Poland" you have to survive your own perilous equilibrium while trying to drink as many bottles of alcohol as possible.   Using WASD keys to move, and your mouse, you will play basically against yourself, trying to get the best score you can.  

[h3][b]How does it perform?[/b][/h3]  Controls are not the best and are quite fudgy.  Graphics are quite basic and, frankly, the music is ennoying.  Past these negatives, the game is actually quite difficult to master.  For instance, I dare anyone to keep a balanced equilibrium and keep at it for 10 minutes in "Poland" while drinking.  When you try it, you will see.  Lots of training required.  

[h3][b]The good points:[/b][/h3] Simple game to understand, but challenging to play. It takes less than 20 MB on your HD and can be played on a 10 years old PC.  The game may have value to offer to anyone interested in this type of entertainment. The game has Steam Trading Cards and is playable on the Steam Deck.  

[h3][b]The bad points:[/b][/h3]  The game has fudgy controls and a lot of randomness. The Tutorial of sort for each minigame is more than basic, and the first two minutes will be spent in confusion until you get the hang of it.  Graphics are basic.  Sound/music is/are ennoying for me. Some people might get ennoyed at the easy clichés found in this game, but it has obviously been done on purpose by the devs.  

[h3][b]My take on this:[/b][/h3] Surprisingly, this is not a bad game.  In spite of its basic graphics and the bad controls, it has value to offer and if you buy it when heavily discounted, you will get your money's worth out of it (unless you do not find any entertainement value out of it).  Buy it only if heavily discounted.

*Giriş:*
Slavistan, çekici sloganı "Merhaba Arkadaşlar!" ve bir Slav olarak kendini kanıtlama vaadiyle oyuncuları Doğu Avrupa kültürü ve gopnik yaşam tarzının dünyasına çeker. [Geliştiricinin Adı] tarafından geliştirilen bu oyun, oyuncuları Slav mizahı ve gopnik yaşam tarzıyla dolu bir dünyaya dalmayı amaçlıyor.

*Grafikler ve Tasarım:*
Oyunun görselleri Doğu Avrupa manzaralarını ve kentsel ayarları karikatürize edilmiş bir şekilde benimser. Grafiti kaplı duvarlardan Kiril alfabesiyle süslenmiş harap binalara kadar her detay Slavistan'ın otantikliğini yansıtır. Karakter tasarımları, abartılı olmasına rağmen, oyunun cazibesine katkıda bulunur; eşofmanlar, Adidas spor ayakkabılar ve elbette ikonik ushanka şapkalar yer alır. Ancak, bazıları bu tasvirin kültürü kutlamak yerine klişeleri pekiştirdiğini düşünebilir.

*Oynanış:*
Slavistan üç ana oyun modu sunar, her biri farklı bir ülkede geçer: Rusya, Ukrayna ve Polonya. Oyun mekaniği nispeten basit olmasına rağmen, hızlı tempolu ve zorlayıcıdır. Amaç moddan moda değişir, squat yarışmalarından votka içme yarışmalarına kadar çeşitlenir. Kontroller sezgiseldir, squat yapma, dans etme ve içki içme gibi eylemler için kaydırma ve dokunma kombinasyonları kullanılır. Ancak, oynanış zamanla tekrarlayıcı hale gelebilir ve başlangıçtaki yenilikten öteye derinlik sunmaz.

*Karakterler ve İlerleme:*
Slavistan'ın öne çıkan özelliklerinden biri, kendi eksantriklikleri ve kişilikleri olan çeşitli karakterlerdir. Deneyimli gopnikten şapşal büyükanneye kadar, oyuncular altı farklı karakteri kilitleyip oynayabilirler. Her karakterin oynayış tarzına çeşitlilik katmak için benzersiz yetenekleri vardır. Ancak, ilerleme sistemi biraz sığ hissettirir, kilidini açılanlar çoğunlukla kozmetik olup çekirdek oyun deneyimine pek etki etmez.

*Mizah ve Kültürel Referanslar:*
Slavistan, oyun boyunca Slav klişelerini ve kültürel referansları benimseyerek mizah üzerine kuruludur. Yaramaz esprilerden squat'a kadar ikonik Slav sembolleriyle alay etmek, oyunun mizahının Doğu Avrupa kültürü hayranlarını kesinlikle etkileyecektir. Ancak, bazıları mizahın klişelere aşırı bağımlı olduğunu düşünerek, Slav kültürünün daha incelikli bir temsiline öncelik verenleri potansiyel olarak dışlayabilir.

*Sonuç:*
Sonuç olarak, Slavistan, gopnik memlerinin ve Doğu Avrupa klişelerinin hayranları için eğlenceli ve hoş bir deneyim sunan Slav kültürüne mizahi ve neşeli bir bakış sunar. Oynanış zamanla tekrarlayıcı hale gelebilir ve mizah bazen klişe sularına girebilir, ancak oyun, Slav mizahını ve dostluğunu yakalamada başarılı olur. Ne kadar deneyimli bir gopnik olursanız olun veya sadece Doğu Avrupa kültürü hakkında meraklıysanız, Slavistan denemeye değer eğlenceli ve eğlendirici bir deneyim sunar.

*Artılar:*
- Slav estetiği ve mizahının otantik tasviri.
- Farklı yeteneklere sahip çeşitli karakterler.
- Sezgisel kontroller ve hızlı tempolu oynanış.

*Eksiler:*
- Oynanış zamanla tekrarlayıcı hale gelebilir.
- Mizah bazı oyuncular için klişelere fazla dayanabilir.
- İlerleme sistemi oyun deneyimine derinlik ve anlamlı etki sunmaz.

I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

《Slavistan》原本寄予厚望能够以其独特的斯拉夫文化背景和趣味盎然的游戏玩法吸引更多玩家的眼球，但在实际体验之后，它似乎并没有兑现承诺，反而因诸多问题饱受批评。

首先游戏的核心机制存在严重缺陷。游戏主打的角色扮演和城市建设元素在执行过程中显得极其生硬，策略深度匮乏，资源管理系统的平衡性欠佳。玩家在游戏中频繁遭遇资源瓶颈，而且决策过程往往过于简化，缺乏策略性思考的空间，这样的设计极大地削减了游戏的可玩性和耐玩度。

其次游戏的文化呈现方式让人大跌眼镜。尽管试图以斯拉夫文化为主题，但游戏中的诸多细节处理流于表面且刻板化，不仅未能准确传达斯拉夫民族的历史底蕴和文化内涵，甚至在部分情节和人物设定上引发了文化误解和不适感。游戏的艺术风格和视觉效果同样无法展现斯拉夫文化的美学特质，让人感觉是在走马观花般敷衍了事。

此外技术层面也存在显著问题。游戏优化不佳，帧数不稳定，尤其是在大规模城市建设和多人在线互动时，卡顿和延迟现象尤为明显。同时游戏中还充斥着各种恼人的BUG，包括但不限于任务无法完成、物品丢失、存档损坏等，这些问题严重影响了玩家的正常游戏体验。

最后不得不提的是剧情编写较为薄弱。主线剧情缺乏连贯性和吸引力，支线任务设计单薄且重复度高，角色对话空洞乏味，很难激发玩家的情感投入。游戏内购系统设计也不够透明，时常令玩家感到被迫消费才能取得实质进展。

综上所述，尽管有着独特的文化背景作为卖点，但在游戏性、文化表达和技术实现等方面均暴露出显著的问题，使得这款本应富有特色的模拟经营游戏最终沦为了玩家心中的败笔之作。我们期待开发者能积极听取社区反馈，进行彻底的迭代优化，以期未来版本能够真正体现出斯拉夫文化的魅力。

"Slavistan" ist eine Mini-Spiel-Sammlung.

Wobei Sammlung schon leicht übertrieben scheint, denn es handelt sich nur um drei unterschiedliche Spiele. 

Das erste, das in Russland spielt, ist ein Tanzwettbewerb. bei dem wir die Pfeiltasten im Takt drücken müssen während wir zum Beispiel rumlaufenden Bären ausweichen müssen. 

Im zweiten, das auf dem Balkan beheimatet ist, bewegen wir nicht nur uns, sondern auch unseren Schlagarm, mit dem wir heranstürmende Gegner in einer Bar wegkloppen müssen. 

Im dritten Spielchen, bei dem wir in Polen sind, müssen wir aufpassen, daß wir nicht seitlich umkippen während wir immer wieder Alkohol trinken. 

Die einzelnen Spiele nehmen sich alle nicht ernst, ironisieren durchaus gekonnt typische Stereotype. Das ist alberne Komik mit dem Holzhammer, die aber durchaus funktioniert. Hilfreich hierfür ist auch die durchaus passende und witzige Pixelgrafik, die altmodisch und zugleich comichaft wirkt. 

Der Umfang ist zwar winzig, aber witzig. Die Dauer der Mini-Spielchen läßt sich in der Regel mit Sekunden beschreiben. Aber die sind, zumindest zu Anfang, durchaus witzig. 

Das größte Problem des Titels ist das Gameplay selbst, denn die Tastaturabfrage ist ungenau und die Maus-Implementierung ist verdammt schwammig. Zudem gibt das Spiel nicht immer klare Rückmeldungen. Auch dadurch werden die Partien oft sehr kurz. 

Mechanisch kann man den Titel also nicht empfehlen. Wer ein gutes Spiel haben möchte, sollte lieber die Finger davon lassen. Wer mit einem sehr kurzen, schnellen, kurzzeitig witzigem Spaß-Spielchen leben kann, findet hier einen passenden albernen Vertreter.

[h1]Игра про гопников - Slavistan[/h1]

[h1]Коротко об игре[/h1]
Играть нам предстоит всего лишь на трёх уровнях, достаточно разнообразных для данной игры, за определённые достижения на уровнях игроку выдается Drinks или по-русски выпивка.

За эту выпивку можно получать новых героев... и всё.

В этом на мой взгляд главная [b]проблема[/b] игры, она вполне разнообразна, но и уровней, и разнообразия мало.
[b]Но разберём все уровни игры отдельно, коих, как я говорил три:[/b]
[h1]Уровень в России[/h1]
На нём наш герой будет танцевать и получать за это от публики водку, которую в свою очередь будут красть медведи (знаю, звучит трешово), а если водки на "сцене" не останется, то медведи съедят нас вместо водки.
Танец осуществляется посредством нажатий стрелочек в нужное время. Вот и всё, что я могу сказать об этом уровне в плане геймплея. Просто но со вкусом, так сказать.

[h1]Уровень на Балканском полуострове[/h1]
Здесь нам придётся отбиваться от разъярённой толпы и... медведей, которые появляются после того как взглянут через окно.

Не знаю, то ли баг, то ли ещё что-то, но у меня медведи подходили середину пути, после чего благополучно застревали и стояли так до конца, хотя анимация ходьбы продолжала работать.
В этом доблестном сражении нам поможет официантка, стоящая за барной стойкой и редко бьющая посудой об наших противников, но убивающая их с одного удара.

Сражение осуществляется посредством движения мышкой и нажатием Space в определенный момент для вызова официантки.

[h1]Уровень в Польше[/h1]
В Польше нашему герою предстоит героически держать баланс определённое время, по истечению которого он получит выпивку.
Удерживать баланс предстоит своевременным нажатием клавиш "A" и "D", звучит просто но на деле весьма сложно.
